products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020, described on its site as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its Falcon LLM program is a family of generative large language models that the institute says it builds to make advanced AI accessible, with efficiency, ethical design, and global scalability in mind. The site presents Falcon as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal, and the institute's product listing describes it as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0, aimed at sovereign AI and Middle East data residency.

The Falcon family spans several models. Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, is described as the first home-grown open source large language model released with weights for research and commercial use. Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens. Later additions include Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon Perception for vision and language tasks, Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic, and instruction-following, Falcon Mamba 7B, which the institute calls the first open source released State Space Language Model, and Falcon 2 11B. The site states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B model, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard.

The institute also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models and their ecosystems, and it runs programs around Falcon 10B, including a Call for Proposals with AI71, a company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, and a Falcon LLM Hackfest. No litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records about the institute appear in the material available here.
